decisions.statement: One initiative has one hold at a time.
A hold for an initiative is the intents that initiative is drawn with.
A hold for an initiative is that the initiative is drawn away.
A hold for an initiative is the color that initiative is drawn in.
A hold naming a color names the seat whose turn color that is.
A hold names the intents held to be going as well as the intents left.
An intent is followed between two orders by its statement rather than its key.
The intents drawn are numbered again from `1` in the order held.
The rows beneath an initiative that are no intent keep their places.
An intent held to be going is left out of the intents drawn.
An initiative held to be gone is left out of the rows drawn.
An initiative held to have a color is drawn in that color wherever that initiative sits.
The rows beneath that initiative keep the colors those rows have.
A file with the intents held in the order held agrees.
A file with the same intents in another order is stale rather than gone.
A file still holding an intent held to be going is stale rather than gone.
A file that lost one of two intents held to be going is stale rather than gone.
A file missing an intent held to be staying is gone rather than stale.
A file holding an intent held neither way is gone rather than stale.
A file without an initiative held to be gone agrees.
A file with an initiative held to be gone is stale rather than gone.
A file drawing an initiative in the color held for it agrees.
A file drawing that initiative in another color or none is stale rather than gone.
A file without an initiative held to have a color is gone rather than stale.
The intents an initiative held to have a color holds are read by nothing here.
An intent taken out while an order is held is taken out of that order.
An order moved while an intent is held to be going keeps that intent going.
An intent no order holds is held to be going by nothing.
The intent an order moves is named by its statement rather than by its place.
The place that intent leaves is read off the order held.
The place an order moves an intent onto is named by the intent already there.
An intent moved onto an intent the order does not hold holds nothing.
Every hold is settled over the rows in the order the holds were made.
A hold the file agrees with is let go.
A hold the file has left behind is let go.
A stale hold still waiting on a landing is settled over the rows and kept.
A hold counts the landings that hold is waiting on.
Making a hold counts one landing more.
A landing answering counts one landing less.
A hold waiting on no landing is let go however the file reads.
A hold outlives no landing that hold was made for.
A landing answering more often than a hold was made counts down to `0`.
Rows are composed here and handed back rather than given to the editor.
Nothing here calls the harness.
Nothing here writes the initiative's page.
Nothing here draws a row.

definition: what the work panel draws for an initiative until the file the service writes has it
